sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Furthermore, we appreciate the updated demand forecast, which we have verified and incorporated into our pricing. We are pleased to accept your proposed 36-month contract duration and the extended 60-day payment terms. 

Based on these parameters and the increased volume, we can offer a revised price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

decisions.tactician: o4 has the longest term at standard payment, which addresses its planning-security and capacity needs, and those are not valued in the cash model. step_25 leaves real room below the midway rung and is less aggressive than E0 or step_10, which reduces the walk-away risk with this low-dependency supplier. Its committee process also means we should move in a few credible steps rather than one deep cut. The volume-growth arguments speak directly to its strongest needs. The delivery-record argument is held back so that a first move framed as partnership is not soured.

decisions.tactician: o4 keeps the terms it already accepted, which gives it the planning security it values, and only moves price. Its pace of about €0.23 per reply suggests step_25 (€5.30) is reachable in one or two rounds while leaving room to settle. E0 at €5.22 sits below step_10 and close to our cost estimate. Pushing that far risks a walk-away from a supplier with low dependency on us, and with a committee cycle per round. The delivery-record argument is fresh, verifiable and justifies the step. Accepting €5.55 now would leave too much value on the table.

why.tactician: Offer:70610-4 gives C €323,429, far below the no-deal cost of €379,916 and close to the best available rung. The only cheaper options save less than about €600: o4 at €5.38 saves €600, o1/o2 at pay 90 d save about €370. Each would mean pushing past a declared final offer against a supplier that can afford to walk, risking roughly €56k of value for a trivial gain. Re-terming at pay 90 d would also reopen a committee cycle. E0's move would push on as well, so accepting now locks in the near-best outcome.
